description: 4 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars ask explicitly for a performance audit: profiling a bottleneck, finding N+1 queries, a hot-path analysis. Near-misses share the speed vocabulary and route elsewhere: a slow test suite (test-performance), implementing a cache (performance), and a database index design (database). Counterexamples guard 'performance' and 'profile' in unrelated senses.

queries.q: profile the order export endpoint and find out where the 4 seconds go
audit this controller for N+1 queries before we ship it
do a hot-path analysis of the pricing calculation, it is called on every request
mach eine Performance-Analyse der Dashboard-API, die Antwortzeiten sind zu hoch
our pest suite takes 12 minutes, speed up the tests
add a Redis cache in front of the product catalogue query
queries.note: implementing an optimisation, not auditing for one → performance

queries.q: which index should the orders table get for this query?
write the quarterly performance review for my direct report
add a profile page where users can change their avatar
